_comment: The libraries served from /vendor/, and which version of each is in use.
scripts/update-vendor.mjs reads this, asks npm whether anything newer
exists inside the same major version, and if so swaps the file, repoints
every <script src> in the site, and updates this file and the README.
'major' is a deliberate ceiling. A new major version means the library
changed in ways that break callers, so those never arrive by robot —
raise the number here by hand when you have time to test it.

libraries.name: supabase-js
libraries.role: Talks to the database. Every page uses it.

libraries.name: emailjs-browser
libraries.role: Sends the confirmation and thank-you emails.

libraries.name: gsap-scrolltrigger
libraries.role: Scroll-driven animation. Must match gsap exactly.
